subject: Question after your note
text: Hey, just circling back after your reply because something popped up. The schedule tweak you mentioned makes sense, and I totally get why you switched things around so late. My only snag is the prep time: if the session moves earlier, I'll probably have to shuffle my own morning, which isn't the end of the world, but I wanted to flag it before we lock it in. Could you let me know whether there's any wiggle room on the start time? If not, I'll figure it out. Also, are you still okay with me bringing the extra snacks, or would that just add clutter? Honestly, I'm cool either way. I just don't want us scrambling at the last minute. Shoot me a quick note when you have a sec, and I'll adjust on my end. Thanks for always keeping me in the loop instead of springing surprises.
